actionableFailures.failure: Codex native delivery body does not contain the original issue URL.
actionableFailures.rootCause: is_work_item_read used a substring match on the whole tool argument JSON. It intercepted the compound pr_title=$(gh issue view ...) && gh pr edit ... command as a standalone read, replacing its execution with a mocked page. Git push and readiness still executed, retaining the WIP body.
actionableFailures.repair: Parse command arguments and match the initial gh issue view prefix only. Preserve the issue-body assertion and add a native regression for compound title/edit commands. Strengthen maintained Codex and Claude checks to require the actual PR edit and issue title.
